item.title: 🔴 Carnival Cruise confirms data breach affecting nearly 6 million people
item.description:
Why this matters: Potential data exposure — check monitoring and incident response readiness.
Carnival Corporation, the world's largest cruise line operator, has confirmed a data breach affecting nearly 6 million people claimed by the ShinyHunters extortion gang in April 2026. [...]
